Primary_Source_Organization_Reviewed: Port of Duqm / Port of Duqm Company
Primary_Source_Title_Reviewed: Port Rules & Regulations, Doc. PODC/HMO/002/MNL, Rev. 01, 1 January 2023; Nautical Information
Primary_Source_Exact_Evidence: The Port Rules publish a multi-point geographic boundary for Port of Duqm. The official nautical-information page separately publishes outer and inner pilot-station positions. These are boundary and pilotage references, not a single port-centre coordinate.
Primary_Source_Coordinate_Text: Port-limit polygon; outer pilot station 19°42.5'N, 057°50.0'E; inner pilot station 19°42.2'N, 057°45.3'E
Primary_Source_Reference_Point: Port boundary polygon and separate pilot stations; no single port reference point established
Secondary_Source_Title_Reviewed: Port of Duqm Commercial — Port Location
Secondary_Source_Exact_Evidence: Wilhelmsen lists the Port of Duqm Commercial port location as latitude 19.65750080 and longitude 57.71450620.
Secondary_Source_Reference_Point: Wilhelmsen commercial port-location point; exact physical point definition unspecified
Coordinate_Conflict_Description: Port of Duqm official rules provide a port-limit polygon and official nautical information provides pilot-station positions, while Wilhelmsen provides a single commercial port-location point at 19.6575008,57.7145062. These are different spatial objects and must not be compared as if they were competing port-centre coordinates. Do not substitute pilot-station coordinates for a port coordinate.
Researcher_Evidence_Conclusion: Official Port of Duqm material establishes the port boundary and separate pilot-station positions, but the reviewed official sources do not establish one representative port-centre coordinate. Wilhelmsen lists 19.6575008,57.7145062 as the commercial port location. Retain this as a secondary location candidate only. Do not derive or claim an official centroid from the port-limit polygon, and do not use the pilot-station positions as the port coordinate. Datum and exact point scope remain pending.

Primary_Source_Title_Reviewed: Mesaieed Port Information and Regulations Guide, January 2025
Primary_Source_Exact_Evidence: The guide identifies Port of Mesaieed (Umm Sa'id / Umm Said) and explicitly gives GISIS Code - UN/LOCODE QAUMS. It defines port limits as a multi-point polygon including the Inner Harbour and Outer Channels to the Mesaieed Approach Buoy.
Primary_Source_Reference_Point: Port limits polygon covering inner harbour and outer channels; not a single representative point
Secondary_Source_Exact_Evidence: Wilhelmsen lists Mesaieed port location at latitude 24.91314500 and longitude 51.57289200.
Secondary_Source_Reference_Point: Wilhelmsen port-location point; exact physical point definition unspecified
Coordinate_Conflict_Description: QatarEnergy's official guide defines a port-limit polygon rather than a single coordinate. Wilhelmsen gives a single location point at 24.913145,51.572892. These are different spatial representations. Do not calculate a centroid and present it as an official port coordinate; do not substitute approach buoy or anchorage coordinates.
Researcher_Evidence_Conclusion: The January 2025 QatarEnergy/Mesaieed Port guide explicitly identifies QAUMS and defines the port limits as a polygon covering the inner harbour and outer channels. It does not publish a single representative port coordinate in the reviewed section. Wilhelmsen lists 24.913145,51.572892 as a port-location point. Retain the Wilhelmsen point as a secondary candidate only; do not convert the port-limit polygon to an invented official point. The exact physical point scope and datum remain unspecified.

Primary_Source_Organization_Reviewed: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE)
Primary_Source_Title_Reviewed: UN/LOCODE Directory — United Arab Emirates, AEAUH Abu Dhabi
Primary_Source_Exact_Evidence: UNECE lists AE AUH as Abu Dhabi, with maritime transport (sea port), road transport and air transport functions; published location coordinates are 24°28'N, 054°22'E (24.4667,54.3667).
Primary_Source_Reference_Point: UN/LOCODE Abu Dhabi multimodal location point; not a named port facility
Secondary_Source_Exact_Evidence: Wilhelmsen lists Abu Dhabi port location at latitude 24.53540000 and longitude 54.39000000.
Secondary_Source_Reference_Point: Wilhelmsen Abu Dhabi port-location point; exact named facility/reference point not stated on reviewed page
Coordinate_Conflict_Description: UNECE UN/LOCODE gives the multimodal Abu Dhabi location point 24.4667,54.3667, while Wilhelmsen lists 24.5354,54.3900 as Abu Dhabi port location. These points differ and the latter's named facility scope is not specified in the reviewed page. Abu Dhabi contains multiple distinct port facilities. Zayed Port pilot boarding coordinates are pilotage points and must not be used as port coordinates.
Researcher_Evidence_Conclusion: UNECE confirms AEAUH as the multimodal Abu Dhabi location and publishes 24.4667,54.3667. Wilhelmsen separately lists an Abu Dhabi port-location point at 24.5354,54.3900. The two points are not equivalent and the exact facility represented by the Wilhelmsen point remains unclear. Abu Dhabi has several separately coded port locations and terminals. Retain both source references without selecting a validated port coordinate until the source-call facility is identified. Do not substitute Zayed Port pilot boarding positions.

Primary_Source_Organization_Reviewed: Government of Ras Al Khaimah; RAK Ports
Primary_Source_Title_Reviewed: Law No. 10 of 2017 — RAK Ports Port Limits; RAK Ports official port information
Primary_Source_Exact_Evidence: The legal schedule defines Ras Al Khaimah Port boundaries using a circle extending 5.5 nautical miles seaward from the main breakwater, whose position is 25°48.7'N, 55°57'E. RAK Ports separately identifies Al Jeer Port, Saqr Port / Free Zone, Ras Al Khaimah Port and Al Jazeera Port as distinct locations.
Primary_Source_Coordinate_Text: Ras Al Khaimah Port main breakwater: 25°48.7'N, 55°57'E
Primary_Source_Reference_Point: Main breakwater of Ras Al Khaimah Port; legal port-boundary reference point, not a port centroid
Secondary_Source_Exact_Evidence: Wilhelmsen lists Mina Saqr at latitude 25.97717100 and longitude 56.05158200. Mina Saqr is a distinct port location and is not treated as corroboration for the Ras Al Khaimah Port main-breakwater position.
Secondary_Source_Reference_Point: Mina Saqr port-location point; separate facility/location from Ras Al Khaimah Port
Coordinate_Conflict_Description: The legal coordinate 25.811667,55.950000 is the main breakwater reference for Ras Al Khaimah Port specifically. RAK Ports operates multiple distinct port locations, including Saqr Port and Al Jazeera Port. Wilhelmsen's Mina Saqr point 25.977171,56.051582 is for a different port and must not be treated as corroboration or as an alternative coordinate for Ras Al Khaimah Port. The AERKT source-call facility mapping remains unresolved.
Researcher_Evidence_Conclusion: Government port-limits legislation provides a legally defined main-breakwater reference at 25.811667,55.950000 for Ras Al Khaimah Port specifically. RAK Ports identifies multiple distinct port locations in the emirate, so the point cannot be generalized to all Ras Al Khaimah facilities. Wilhelmsen's Mina Saqr coordinate is a separate port and is not corroboration. Retain the legal breakwater position as a facility-specific candidate only; do not assign it to AERKT source calls until the exact facility is mapped. Datum and final scope approval remain pending.
